text.body: || atha śanistotram || śrīḥ || asya śrīśanaiścarastotrasya daśaratha ṛṣiḥ śanaiścaro devata triṣṭupachaṃdaḥ śanaiścaraprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || daśaratha uvāca || koṇā'ntako raudrayamo'tha babhruḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaniḥ piṃgalamaṃda sauriḥ || nityaṃ smṛto yo harate ca pīḍāṃ tasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya || 1 || surāsuraḥ kiṃpurūṣā gaṇeṃdrā gandharvavidyādharapannagāśca || pīḍyaṃti sarve viṣamasthitena tasmai nāmaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya || 2 || narā nareṃdrāḥ paśavo mṛgeṃdrā vanyāśca ye kīṭapataṃgabhṛṃgā || pīḍyaṃti sarve viṣamasthitena tasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya || 3 || deśāśca durgāṇi vanāni yatra senāniveśāḥ purapattanāti || pīḍyaṃti sarve viṣamasthitena tasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya || 4 || tilairyavairmāṣaguḍannadānairlohena nīlāṃbaradānato vā || prīṇāti maṃtrairnijavāsare ca tasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya || 5 || prayākūle yamunātaṭe ca sarasvatī puṇyajale guhāyām‌ || yo yogināṃ dhyānagato'pi sūkṣmastasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya || 6 || anyapradeśātsvagṛhaṃ praviṣṭastadīyavāre sa naraḥ sūkhī syāt‌ || gṛhād‌ gato yo na punaḥ prayāti tasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya namaḥ || 7 || sraṣṭā syaṃbhūrbhuvanatarasya trātā hariḥ saṃharate pinākī || ekastridhā ṛgyajuḥsāmamūrtitasmai namaḥ śrīravinaṃdanāya namaḥ || 8 || śanyaṣṭakaṃ yaḥ prayataḥ prabhāte nityaṃ suputraiḥ paśubāṃdhavaiśca || paṭhecca saukhyaṃ bhuvi bhogayuktaṃ prāpnoti nirvāṇapadaṃ paraṃ saḥ || 9 || koṇasthaḥ piṃgalo babhraḥ kṛṣṇā raudrā'ntako yamaḥ || sauriḥśaneścaro maṃdaḥ pippalādena saṃstutaḥ || 10 || etāni daśa nāmāni prātarutthāpa yaḥ paṭhet || śanaiścarakṛtā pīḍā na kadācid‍bhaviṣyati || 11 || iti śrīdaśarathaproktaṃ śanaiścarastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
